=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Line or code reference: 112 (printf | tee -a pipeline in emit_run_budget_gate_note)
  Problem: The function body contains `printf '...' | tee -a "${budget_log_file}" >&2` under the script-level `set -euo pipefail` declared at line 2. When tee fails — disk full, permission denied on the log directory, missing parent path — the pipeline exits non-zero via pipefail, and set -e terminates the entire reviewer run.
  Why it fails at runtime: This function is called from `execute_reviewer_attempt` (line 3189) with a real `log_file` argument. A transient filesystem error on that log path converts a best-effort budget diagnostic into a hard crash that aborts the reviewer pipeline mid-run, discarding all reviewer and editor work already completed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
